heading: ✦ The omikuji ritual ✦

dialogue.ready: Breathe slowly. When your heart is still, we can begin.
dialogue.praying: Your wish has been offered to the kami…
dialogue.shaking: The omikuji listen for the echo of fate…
dialogue.stick: Of all the paths, one has chosen you.
dialogue.wallet: Please confirm the transaction in your wallet. It records your draw on BOT Chain and costs a small gas fee.
dialogue.confirming: Waiting for confirmation on BOT Chain Mainnet…
dialogue.paper: Slowly, your fortune is being written…
dialogue.error: The ritual was interrupted. You can try again.

kamiNote: Kami are the deities and spirits honored at Shinto shrines.
